summary: Sprint-3+4 Combined Testing (Iteration 93) - Family Gates, Learning Memory, Decision Cards, Explainability. All backend APIs working correctly (15/15 tests pass). Frontend pages tested: UserScannerPage (decision cards with learning badges, explainability panel), AdminCanonicalStrategyRegistryPage (family gates panel with 4 families), AdminLearningPanelPage (strategy/family memory tables, recommendations with apply). Fixed critical bug in learning_memory_service.py where UNIQUE constraint on pending_signal_id was failing during refresh.
seed_data_creation: None required - used existing test users
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint-3+4 implementation verified. All backend endpoints working: GET/PUT /api/admin/strategy-family-gates, GET /api/admin/blocked-reason-timeline/{symbol}, GET /api/user/decision-cards, GET /api/user/decision-cards/{symbol}, GET /api/user/explainability/{symbol}, GET /api/user/learning/safe-surface, POST /api/admin/learning/refresh, GET /api/admin/learning/overview, POST /api/admin/learning/recommendations/{id}/apply. Frontend routes: /user/scanner for UserScannerPage, /admin/canonical-strategy-registry for family gates, /admin/learning-panel for learning memory. Fix applied to learning_memory_service.py to handle unique constraint on pending_signal_id when same pending signal is referenced by multiple scanner results.
rca_of_the_issue: Fixed bug in refresh_learning_memory() - UNIQUE constraint failed on pending_signal_id when multiple scanner results referenced the same pending signal. Solution: Track used pending_signal_ids and only assign if not already used.
